scope: one original flight, structural QC first; no release counterfactual execution
selection: Prefer ATom; if inaccessible, first lexically ordered AirCore Level2 final text profile with matching INI and Level1 met in obtained archive; no outcome-based reselection
join_rule: Use provider Level2 alignment; never join laboratory analysis clock directly to flight clock; no nearest join or interpolation
row_rules: finite positive ambient pressure and temperature
dry CH4 nonnegative and uncertainty finite nonnegative
provider QC and diffusion support retained
unique observation identifiers; repeated timestamp reported not silently averaged
layer_note: Analyst-declared diagnostic bands, not policy thresholds. Use only observed supported layers, never force sea-level observations at elevated launch site. Bounds lower-inclusive upper-exclusive; at least two layers needed for comparison.
independence: Record counts are not independent sample counts; air sample diffusion, time covariance and air-mass representativeness must enter error budget
detection_rule: Only after complete uncertainty budget: preregister contrast and uncertainty coverage; interval excluding zero may support descriptive difference, never release-height causality
equivalence_rule: No numeric equivalence margin approved; H0 cannot be accepted just because a difference is non-significant. Future metric-specific margin must be justified before model outcomes.
if_global_evidence_missing: NO_VALID_VERTICAL_PROFILE for Stage2 quantitative comparison; structural QC remains permitted; global block is not row invalidity
